text:
Diego Morales: hey all  new here and running into two cloud puzzles during my first-day setup. hoping someone can point me to the right flow.
Diego Morales: (1) GCP: when I try to link project 'redwood-experiments' to billing I get "Billing account not found" in the console. I only have Viewer on the project and no billing permissions.
Diego Morales: (2) AWS: my dev role shows up but any attempt to create CloudWatch log groups returns AccessDenied. CLI error: "User: arn:aws:iam::999111222333:user/diego is not authorized to perform: logs:CreateLogGroup".
Anya Patel: welcome Diego! for AWS I can help, cc'ing Ravi who handles the role attachments. Do you see the role as an assumed role or a user in the top-right of the console?
Diego Morales: it shows my user, not an assumed role. I was expecting to be using the 'Redwood-Developer' role via SSO but maybe that didn't bind.
Ravi Shah: hi Diego  I see your SSO assignment didn't finish. I'll re-run the assignment workflow. Quick workaround: if you sign out and re-open the SSO link https://sso.redwood.com/start and select "Redwood-Developer" it should create a session with the right permissions.
Diego Morales: re-signed into SSO and now I appear as arn:aws:sts::999111222333:assumed-role/Redwood-Developer/Diego. trying the create log group command again.
Diego Morales: create succeeded! thanks Ravi 44d
Anya Patel: nice. for GCP billing: finance manages billing accounts. @finance-bot can you paste the onboarding checklist link and required fields? we usually need the billing account id (BA-xxxx), project id, justification, and manager approval.
finance-bot: Onboarding billing flow: please open https://access.redwood.com > New Request > Cloud Billing. Required: project id, billing account id (if known), manager email, and business justification. Expected turnaround: 1 business day.
Diego Morales: thanks, filing now. one weird thing: my project-level permissions include roles/viewer, but when I open Billing > Budget > Create Budget the console grays out the controls. Is that because I need project/billing.admin too?
Anya Patel: correct. roles/billing.admin on the project or billing.user on the billing account is needed to create budgets or link. If you don't have it we can link the project ourselves after approval.
Diego Morales: submitted request INC-10023 with project id redwood-experiments and noted manager is @Anya Patel.
finance-bot: Ticket INC-10023 created. Status: Pending finance approval. Link: https://access.redwood.com/tickets/INC-10023
Ravi Shah: fyi for others: sometimes org policy blocks certain regions (like ap-south1) for billing or resource creation. If anyone needs APAC regions, include region justification in the ticket so finance/security can pre-approve.
Diego Morales: good to know—I'm planning to run experiments in us-west2 for now. thanks everyone, both issues resolved from my side once SSO and the ticket were in motion :tada:
onboarding-bot: Reminder: complete the cloud onboarding checklist within 24 hours to avoid delays: https://onboarding.redwood.com/checklist
